summary: The contracts are detailed and generally fail-closed, but the scanner can miss concurrently added source files and can promote foreign-framework focused calls to P0 findings; its mandatory Python dependency is also undocumented.

findings.title: Frozen manifest omits newly added source files
findings.evidence: Final validation iterates only the previously recorded CANDIDATE_IDENTITY_FILE. It does not repeat no-ignore source discovery, so a supported source file created after initial discovery is absent from every identity check and a clean Summary can still be emitted.
findings.recommendation: Repeat source discovery before each tier and before Summary, comparing the complete NUL-delimited path set and identities with the original manifest; exit 2 on additions, removals, or drift.

findings.title: Foreign focused-test binding can become P0
findings.evidence: The fallback accepts bare test/it/describe-style receivers after checking only local declaration shadowing. An imported foreign-framework `it` in a file that also has Playwright provenance can therefore be reported as an unsuppressible #7 P0 despite the documented requirement to reject foreign-framework receivers.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the receiver's import lineage before accepting fallback globals, and reject bindings imported from known foreign frameworks or other non-Playwright/Cypress modules.

findings.title: Scanner has an undocumented mandatory Python dependency
findings.evidence: candidate_identity returns failure when no bound Python 3 executable exists, and manifest recording then exits 2. Public guidance states that bundled checks require PCRE2 ripgrep but does not identify Python as mandatory for every scan.
findings.recommendation: Document the supported Python requirement in README.md, SECURITY.md, and the reviewer prerequisites, including the fail-closed exit behavior when it is unavailable.

limitations: Packet-only static review; no commands, tests, benchmarks, holdouts, network checks, repository history, or runtime observations were used.
The curated subset omits referenced helpers, fixtures, CI tests, agent manifests, and other product surfaces, so their behavior and parity were not assessed.
Scores address contract and verification design only, not observed skill accuracy, benchmark performance, evidence integrity, full product coverage, or remote model attestation.
